editorial:
Imagine waking up in a cold, creepy abandoned factory with five other strangers and realizing you have been kidnapped. That is exactly what happens to the teens in this flick. You will feel the panic as they figure out they are actually stars in a sick reality show called Are You Scared? The vibe is very tense, and you will spend most of the time wondering who is pulling the strings and which of the group will make it out alive. It feels like a deadly game where the rules change just when you think you have a handle on things.

The action keeps moving fast, and the twists keep you guessing until the end. While some of the acting is a bit stiff, the suspense makes up for it. If you love movies where people are trapped in one place and forced to fight, you will really enjoy this. For the best experience, you should look for the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a weekend binge with friends who like a good scare.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the entire game was set up by people who wanted to see how far humans would go to survive for entertainment. After a lot of fighting and betrayal, only a few survivors remain. They finally find a way out of the factory, but they realize the people running the show are still watching them. It ends on a dark note, showing that the game might not actually be over for them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival games and twisty thrillers.
